body.name: \((P_\varepsilon)_{|\varepsilon|<3/110}\)
body.construction: Under \(P_\varepsilon\), \((D,Z)\) has masses \((1/2,1/4,1/4)\) at \((0,0),(1,0),(1,2)\); the first cell outcome is uniform on \([0,1]\), the second is \(\operatorname{Beta}(9,1)\), and the third has density \(f_\varepsilon(y)=f_0(y)[1+\varepsilon(y-3/10)/(21/1100)]\) on \([0,1]\), where \(f_0\) is the \(\operatorname{Beta}(3,7)\) density
